lines: Mohabbat karne wale kam na honge
couplets.en: There will be no shortage of those who love you.

lines: Teri mehfil mein lekin hum na honge
couplets.en: But I will be absent from your gathering.

lines: Mohabbat karne wale kam na honge
couplets.en: There will be no shortage of those who love you.

lines: Zamane bhar ke gham ya ek tera gham
couplets.en: What weighs more, all the sorrows of the world or the one I bear for you?

lines: Ye gham hoga to kitne gham na honge
couplets.en: With this one sorrow, how many others would fall away?

lines: Teri mehfil mein lekin hum na honge
couplets.en: But I will be absent from your gathering.

lines: Mohabbat karne wale kam na honge
couplets.en: There will be no shortage of those who love you.

lines: Agar tu ittifaqan mil bhi jaaye
couplets.en: We may yet meet again by chance.

lines: Teri furqat ke sadme kam na honge
couplets.en: The pain of being apart will scarcely ease.

lines: Teri mehfil mein lekin hum na honge
couplets.en: But I will be absent from your gathering.

lines: Dilon ki uljhanen badhti rahengi
couplets.en: Our hearts will only grow more tangled.

lines: Agar kuchh mashware baham na honge
couplets.en: That is what silence between us will do.

lines: Teri mehfil mein lekin hum na honge
couplets.en: But I will be absent from your gathering.

lines: Mohabbat karne wale kam na honge
couplets.en: There will be no shortage of those who love you.

lines: Hafiz, un se main jitna bad-guman hoon
couplets.en: Hafiz, I have let myself doubt them so deeply.

lines: Woh mujh se us qadar barham na honge
couplets.en: Surely they bear me no such ill will.
